# What occupancy does your dog boarding and daycare business need to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free dog boarding and daycare profit calculator: runs, daycare spots, prices, occupancy and attendant ratio become monthly profit, staffing steps, break-even occupancy, the cash reserve for ramp-up, loan coverage and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
